generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per tender document

technicalCriterionList.description: Last five years achieved at least in two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs. One time of Indent amount.

Satisfactoriy completed at least 50% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 50% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).For Reserved Tenders Satisfactoriy completed at least 25% of this contract as a Prime contractor of same works not less than 25% of Tender amount ( work done certificate for same work should be submitted which is issued by Deputy Conservator of Forests only).
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of owning the following Key and critical equipment for this work.GPS and other Survey instruments And Soil excavator such as Hitachi/Jcb
Line of credit including E-tender Indent No & addressed to undersigned not less then 30% of the Tender amount received from any Nationalized Bank
Contractor should be registered as Forest Contractor in Karnataka Forest Department for the year 2026-27
Income tax returned filed documents for the last three financial year to be enclosed.
A copy of GST no registered under GST act.
Details of goods carriage vehicle, labor service, list of machineries & materials, equipments owned by the contractor.
For address proof any only copy of Adhar,PAN Card, Voter ID, Telephone bill within two months, Ration Card, Bank Pass book, ID issued any Corporation/TP to be uploaded).
A copy of List of Skilled, semi skilled, un skilled labours including EPF & ESI details to be uploaded) along with copy of Registration in Labour Department, EPF & ESI Registration Certificate
Caste Certificate Compulsory (for reserved category tenders)
Submission of Bid capacity (5 years Turnover) Amount of works contracted by contractors in all departments in the year 2026-27 (indent-wise) and turnover for the last five years

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Maintenance of one year plantation Bhadarwadi Cross to Kavalewadi Road 5.00 Km in Khanapur Range

itemList.description: Watering to the polythene-bagged seedlings twice a day. 1.4.2026-15.6.2026-76 Days
Shifting and grading the polythene-bhagged seedlings.
Re-opening of pits of size 1mx1mx1mx for replacement of casualities-30 pits.

Refilling of pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower side and refilling 75% of the pit with the excavated soil duty breaking the clods and formation of saucer shaped mound on the lower side of the pit size 1mx1m x1m for replacement of casualities.
Loading of polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings into vehicle at the nursery site and unloading at the site nearest to the planting site. Seedlings raised in 14" x 20" size bags
Transportation: Transportation: Transportation of polythene/HDPE bagged seedlings in vehicle from nursery site to planting site. Distance from 21 to 30 Km.
Watering polythene / HDPE bagged seedlings at planting site by dipping in water (including carrying of water) only in dry conditions of weather.-14" x 20" and above size bagged seedlings.

Conveyance of tall seedlings raised in HDPE Bags of size 14 x20 from the dumping point site to planting site near each pit on head load, fixing the supporting stake firmly in the pit, planting the tall tall seedlings in the pit tying the seedling to the supporting stake at 3 points (excluding cost of supporting stake) (14 x20 Planting)

Procurment, Transportation & fixing of 10 feet length & 10- 15cm girth marihala Bamboo/wooden/Eucalyptus stakes, Each of the Bamboo/wooden sticks is to be dipped in hot liquid coal tar to a minimum length of 5 feet
Cutting and collection of P. J. branches loading the same into the lorry and unloading at the planting site (8-10 branches per plant).

Conveyance of P. J. branches to individual pit, tying P. J. branches around the supporting stake properly covering the tall plant with P. J. thorny branches to a height of more than 2m. and tying the P. J. branches with G. I. wire at 3 places (10 P. J. branches to be used for tying the tall seedling).
First Weeding around the plants (pit) to radius of 60 cm
Scraping of grass and other growth around the tall plant to a radius of 60 cm (Pits)
Hoeing and soil working with pickaxe around the plant to a depth of 15cm. & to a radius of 60 cm so as to loosen the soil around the plants (pits only).
Watering to the seedlings along roadside and in the city limits at 50 liters/plants 3 times. April & May) (Nos are Flex)
Protection of plantation as per the standard norms (One Watcher for 3 km as a unit).1.4.2026 to 31.3.2027-365 days
Protection of the plantation as per the standard norms.(for 3 KM. as unit during the year) and pro-rate for different extent for the actual period)
Procurement and application of plant protection and growth promotion compounds/material and various other expenses including rounding off.
